title: Target accuracy / %
description: Accuracy the budgets protect, 50–100. OK budget = OKs still allowed if every other remaining note is a GREAT; a miss costs two OKs.

title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a two-row strip for wide boxes, one line for short ones (under about 100 px, e.g. a 4-player replay cell), a column for tall ones.

title: Alignment
description: left: accuracy on the left, OK budget on the right. right: mirrored, for a page on the right of the screen. center applies to the column layout.

title: Backing
description: none: text floats on the game with a light shadow. scrim: a soft shade that fades out around the readout. panel: a graphite panel.

title: Accent colour
description: map: the OK budget and headroom band take the current map's tonal accent (from its background). 18-lab: always amber. Judgement colours never change.
